noUndoRequired: Removal cannot be undone. Confirm each app with --ack-no-undo
profile: Invalid profile, catalog ID or schema
incompatible: The selected item is incompatible with this Windows installation
recovery: Recovery, an active lock or a conflicting change requires attention
administrator: Run this operation as administrator in the interactive session
io: Unable to read or write the requested file
notFound: No installed or recorded package was found
unverified: Review the sources and acknowledge this ID with --ack-unverified
gamingRisk: May break Minecraft Bedrock, Game Pass, Store games or Xbox accessories. Confirm with --ack-gaming-risk
undoPreview: Undo preview. No changes were made
appxWarning: App removal preview. Applying removes the app for all users and new profiles. Undo does NOT reinstall apps or recover their data. Use the separate Store action to reinstall
appxUndo: Undo does NOT reinstall apps. Run appx reinstall ID to preview the Store link
storeOpened: Store product page opened. Complete installation in the Store
storePreview: Store link preview. No page was opened and no app was installed
risk: Review the item risk and acknowledge this ID with --ack-risk
analysis: Read-only analysis. Selected items are marked [x]. No changes were made
incomplete: Incomplete inventory. No action was authorized
currentUserOnly: Appx: current user only; other users and provisioning unknown
allUsers: Appx: all users and provisioned packages
catalog: Embedded catalog. Listing does not inspect Windows
help:
Ametista CLI — offline Windows configuration
Usage: ametista-cli [--profile safe|balanced|aggressive|PROFILE.json] [--dry-run] [--json] [--lang pt-BR|en]
Default: safe profile, read-only, no administrator required
--list                    List embedded catalog without querying Windows
--apply --confirm         Explicitly authorize changes; run elevated
--undo [all|ID]           Preview undo; add --apply --confirm to restore
--ack-risk ID             Acknowledge a selected high-risk item
--ack-unverified ID       Acknowledge an unverified item after review
appx remove ID            Preview one app removal
  --apply --confirm --ack-no-undo [--ack-gaming-risk] [--ack-unverified ID]
appx reinstall ID         Preview validated Store links
  --apply --confirm       Open product page through the interactive desktop
appx reconcile ID         Preview pending removal; add --apply --confirm to reconcile
--json | --text           JSON or readable output (default: readable)
--version | --help        Version or help
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 arguments/profile; 3 partial results; 4 confirmation/policy; 5 access; 6 recovery/conflict; 7 platform/operation
Appx removal cannot be undone. Automatic profiles never remove Appx. Dry-run does not create a journal, restore point, directory or log
legacyData: Previous-version data exists in ProgramData. Writing is blocked. Preserve the old folder; no data was moved or deleted.
